optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Data Analytics Engineer, Equipment Maintenance Services

professionalSummary.text: Data Analytics Engineer with two years of experience building and maintaining pipelines that join machine telemetry with work-order history, maintaining failure-prediction features for the planning team, and documenting data lineage for the maintenance analytics warehouse.
professionalSummary.witness: Responsibilities included pipeline development, feature maintenance, data-review coordination and lineage documentation for the maintenance analytics warehouse over about two years.

experienceHighlights.text: Built hourly pipeline joining vibration/temperature telemetry with work-order history using Spark on Databricks, including late-arrival handling for telemetry uploaded post-site visit.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built the hourly pipeline that joins vibration and temperature telemetry from customer machines with work-order history in the analytics warehouse (Spark jobs on Databricks), including the late-arrival handling for telemetry uploaded after a site visit.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained failure-prediction feature set (rolling vibration stats, days since last service, part age) consumed by planning team's model, versioning feature changes with machine family notes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the failure-prediction feature set (rolling vibration statistics, days since last service, part age) consumed by the planning team's model, versioning each feature change with a note on the affected machine families.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated schema and feature changes with planning and platform teams during fortnightly data reviews, with platform lead approving warehouse schema and planning lead approving feature changes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated schema changes with the planning and platform teams in the fortnightly data review; the platform lead approved warehouse schema changes and the planning lead approved feature changes.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented data lineage for telemetry-work-order join pipeline, including source tables, late-arrival rule, and limitation regarding machines without telemetry gateways.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the lineage note for the telemetry-work-order join, listing the source tables, the late-arrival rule and the known limitation that machines without a telemetry gateway are absent from the features.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Feature-set change log for one quarter and lineage note for telemetry-work-order join, with Databricks job identifiers as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the feature-set change log for one quarter and the lineage note for the telemetry-work-order join, with the Databricks job identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Spark, Databricks, data pipeline development, feature engineering, data lineage documentation, cross-team coordination
skills.witness: Built the hourly pipeline that joins vibration and temperature telemetry from customer machines with work-order history in the analytics warehouse (Spark jobs on Databricks)... Maintained the failure-prediction feature set (rolling vibration statistics, days since last service, part age) consumed by the planning team's model... Coordinated schema changes with the planning and platform teams in the fortnightly data review... Wrote the lineage note for the telemetry-work-order join

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience with pipeline development, feature maintenance, coordination, and documentation as described in the job requirements. The materials do not establish measurable increases in failure catch rates against a published baseline.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required due to unverified claim about measurable increase in failure catch rates.

role.roleTitle: Data Analytics Engineer, Equipment Maintenance Services

evidence.text: Built the hourly pipeline that joins vibration and temperature telemetry from customer machines with work-order history in the analytics warehouse (Spark jobs on Databricks), including the late-arrival handling for telemetry uploaded after a site visit.

Maintained the failure-prediction feature set (rolling vibration statistics, days since last service, part age) consumed by the planning team's model, versioning each feature change with a note on the affected machine families.

Recruiter screen: candidate said the planning team told him the model 'now catches about two thirds of failures early, up from maybe half'; he said the numbers were the planning team's, that he had not seen the evaluation, and that several other changes were made to the model in the same period.
evidence.notes: Candidate did not verify or own the metric

evidence.text: Wrote the lineage note for the telemetry-work-order join, listing the source tables, the late-arrival rule and the known limitation that machines without a telemetry gateway are absent from the features.
